rows.label: SPOT
rows.clue: A point located with respect to surface features of some region

rows.label: BEDSIDE
rows.clue: Space by the side of a bed (especially the bed of a sick or dying person)

rows.label: COUNTY LINE
rows.clue: The boundary between two counties

rows.label: PLAZA
rows.clue: A public square with room for pedestrians

rows.label: CAR PARK
rows.clue: A lot where cars are parked

rows.label: JUNKYARD
rows.clue: A field where junk is collected and stored for resale

rows.label: IONOSPHERE
rows.clue: The outer region of the Earth's atmosphere

rows.label: MEGALOPOLIS
rows.clue: A very large urban complex (usually involving several cities and towns)

rows.label: ARCHDIOCESE
rows.clue: The diocese of an archbishop

rows.label: COMMUNE
rows.clue: The smallest administrative district of several European countries

rows.label: SNOW LINE
rows.clue: The line on a mountain above which there is perpetual snow and ice

rows.label: LOADING AREA
rows.clue: A stop where carriers can be loaded and unloaded

rows.label: BEELINE
rows.clue: The most direct route

rows.label: SANDS
rows.clue: The region of the shore of a lake or sea or ocean

rows.label: HEMISPHERE
rows.clue: Half of the terrestrial globe

rows.label: REACH
rows.clue: The limits within which something can be effective

rows.label: POLLS
rows.clue: The place where people vote

rows.label: LOAD LINE
rows.clue: Waterlines to show the level the water should reach when the ship is properly loaded

rows.label: PARK
rows.clue: A large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property

rows.label: THEME PARK
rows.clue: An amusement park that is organized around some theme (as the world of tomorrow)

rows.label: DESKTOP
rows.clue: The top of a desk

rows.label: GREAT CIRCLE
rows.clue: A circular line on the surface of a sphere formed by intersecting it with a plane passing through the center

rows.label: TRASH DUMP
rows.clue: A piece of land where waste materials are dumped

rows.label: POLAR CIRCLE
rows.clue: A line of latitude at the north or south poles

rows.label: VENUE
rows.clue: The scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)

rows.label: CITY
rows.clue: A large and densely populated urban area
